title: 查询差绝对值的最小值
summary: 对每个子数组查询，求其中任意两个不同数值的最小绝对差；不足两个不同值则返回负一。
insight: 数值只在一到一百。为每个前缀保存各值出现次数，查询时扫描值域，找出区间内依次出现的不同值并更新相邻差；有序数值的最小差必在相邻出现值之间。
pitfalls: 要求两个数值不同，重复值差零不计
值域固定使每次扫描一百项

solutions.title: 值域频次前缀
solutions.idea: 用前缀频次判断每个值是否出现在查询区间。
steps: prefix[i+1] 复制 prefix[i] 并增加 nums[i]
对 [left,right] 扫描 value=1..100，出现条件 prefix[right+1][v]>prefix[left][v]
维护 previous，更新最小 value-previous；无两值返回 -1

code.java: class Solution { public int[] minDifference(int[] nums,int[][] queries){int[][] prefix=new int[nums.length+1][101];for(int i=0;i<nums.length;i++){prefix[i+1]=prefix[i].clone();prefix[i+1][nums[i]]++;}int[] answer=new int[queries.length];for(int q=0;q<queries.length;q++){int previous=-1,best=101,left=queries[q][0],right=queries[q][1]+1;for(int value=1;value<=100;value++)if(prefix[right][value]>prefix[left][value]){if(previous!=-1)best=Math.min(best,value-previous);previous=value;}answer[q]=best==101?-1:best;}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun minDifference(nums:IntArray,queries:Array<IntArray>):IntArray{val prefix=Array(nums.size+1){IntArray(101)};for(i in nums.indices){prefix[i].copyInto(prefix[i+1]);prefix[i+1][nums[i]]++};return IntArray(queries.size){q->var previous=-1;var best=101;val left=queries[q][0];val right=queries[q][1]+1;for(value in 1..100)if(prefix[right][value]>prefix[left][value]){if(previous!=-1)best=minOf(best,value-previous);previous=value};if(best==101)-1 else best}} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: vector<int> minDifference(vector<int>& nums,vector<vector<int>>& queries){vector<array<int,101>> prefix(nums.size()+1);for(int i=0;i<(int)nums.size();++i){prefix[i+1]=prefix[i];++prefix[i+1][nums[i]];}vector<int> answer;for(auto& query:queries){int previous=-1,best=101;for(int value=1;value<=100;++value)if(prefix[query[1]+1][value]>prefix[query[0]][value]){if(previous!=-1)best=min(best,value-previous);previous=value;}answer.push_back(best==101?-1:best);}return answer;} };
